technical.summary: Short-term momentum is strong with volume spike and breakout signals, but overbought conditions and price below intermediate moving averages create conflicting signals; moderate risk/reward for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: EEM shows no fundamental conviction signals—zero insider activity, no institutional positioning, no government contracts, no lobbying, and minimal retail interest.

sentiment.summary: No current congressional signal; Fear index (40) presents mild contrarian opportunity, but stale trades (630+ days old) and absent news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress: inverted yield curve signals recession, VIX at crisis levels (277.6), NFP event today creates binary risk, and emerging markets face severe headwinds from risk-off sentiment and credit stress.

debate.key_bull_argument: Volume spike (15x), Donchian breakout, and CMF cross-up signal short-term momentum reversal in a fear-zone contrarian setup.
debate.key_bear_argument: Critical macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 277.6, NFP event today), price below both 50-day moving averages, overbought technicals, zero fundamental conviction, and no active strategy triggers create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Volume spike and Donchian breakout offer short-term momentum, but macro environment is too hostile to justify entry risk.
decision.primary_risk: NFP event today creates binary risk; inverted yield curve and VIX crisis (277.6) signal severe emerging market headwinds that will likely overwhelm technical momentum.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: No sector concentration risk; however, 278 open positions and macro crisis conditions argue for capital preservation over new swing entries.
